name: Elara Vance
title: Seeker of the Arcane

attacks.name: Quarterstaff
attacks.notes: Versatile (1d8 when used with two hands).

features.title: Wizard Spellcasting
features.desc: You can cast wizard spells you have prepared. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

features.title: Arcane Recovery
features.desc: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be level 6 or higher.

features.title: Evocation Savant
features.desc: Choose two wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

features.title: Sculpt Spells
features.desc: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

features.title: Darkvision
features.desc: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.title: Fey Ancestry
features.desc: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.title: Trance
features.desc: You don't need to sleep. Instead, you meditate deeply for 4 hours a day to gain the benefit of a long rest.

features.title: High Elf Cantrip
features.desc: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you select this species).

equipment: A quarterstaff, a spellbook, a scholar's pack, a component pouch, and a letter from a dead mentor.

personality.traits: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition, and I am never without my spellbook.
personality.ideal: Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge.
personality.bond: I work to preserve the ancient library of my mentor, which was thought to be lost.
personality.flaw: I am easily distracted by the promise of new information or a rare, forgotten text.
personality.notes: Elara is a player-facing sample character demonstrating a complete 2024 rules Wizard.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.desc: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.

spells.name: Light
spells.desc: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by another creature and cause it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.desc: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use it to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or stow or retrieve an item.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.desc: You create one of several minor magical effects, such as a harmless sensory effect, a small mark, or a trinket that lasts until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.desc: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.desc: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range, dealing 1d4+1 force damage.

spells.name: Shield
spells.desc: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC and take no damage from Magic Missile.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.desc: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

spells.name: Web
spells.desc: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube and lightly obscure the area.

equippedGear.name: Quarterstaff
equippedGear.description: A simple melee weapon that can be wielded one- or two-handed.

equippedGear.name: Spellbook
equippedGear.description: A leather-bound tome holding Elara's prepared wizard spells.

equippedGear.name: Scholar's Pack
equippedGear.description: A backpack, a book of lore, an ink bottle, an ink pen, and parchment.

equippedGear.name: Component Pouch
equippedGear.description: A small watertight pouch holding material components for spellcasting.
